svg.title: Rail signal technician — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as rail signal technician, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A two-aspect railway signal stands beside a separate test probe and curved electrical lead. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
